## Unblinding

Compound: **cytochalasin D** (PubChem CID [5458428](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/5458428))

Identity check: name only (the BBBC021 structure is not in PubChem)

ChEMBL mechanisms: no curated mechanism in ChEMBL

## Verdict (computed by code)

Incorrect: agent said **Eg5 inhibitors**, BBBC021 annotates **Actin disruptors**.

## Reflection

Unblinded truth is cytochalasin D, an actin disruptor, while I concluded Eg5 inhibitors at p=0.50 then p=0.35. The actin signal was present from the start: act_std z=+139.0 to +179.3 and act_glcm_contrast z=+104.4 to +138.0 at 1-10 uM (e3, e4), but I read rounded cells and high frac_mitotic_like z=+17.4 with rho=+1.00 (e2, e7) as true mitotic arrest.

Several clues were misweighted. Low doses already showed low nuc_solidity and multinucleation (e13, e14), and the key 0.03 uM threshold was discordant: rep1 mitotic-like enriched versus rep2 with frac_multinucleate_proxy z=+21.8 and frac_large_nucleus z=+11.9 and no mitotic enrichment (e2 vs e15). In hindsight the magnitude of the actin texture plus multinucleation with cell loss should have outranked tubulin contrast. Cytochalasin D caps actin filaments to block polymerization (PMID 3023337) with direct capping/severing observed structurally (PMID 40658853) and binding to monomeric actin (PMID 3782101), which explains contracted high-contrast actin, irregular nuclei, and failed cytokinesis mimicking mitosis in low-resolution features.

What was right:
- Detected a potent dose-dependent phenotype with rounding, falling solidity, and cell loss starting at 0.01-0.03 uM (e2, e11, e14).
- Recorded low-dose multinucleate/large-nucleus signal (e13-e15) that is consistent with actin cytokinesis failure.
- Atlas did retrieve actin disruptors among top hits at high and threshold doses (e6, e20) and low-dose atlases argued against Eg5 (e16, e17, e21).

What was wrong or missed:
- Misclassified actin-driven rounding/contraction as Eg5-mediated mitotic arrest based on frac_mitotic_like (e2, e7) and tub_glcm_contrast (e3, e4).
- Dismissed huge actin signals act_std and act_glcm_contrast (e3, e4) as secondary and lowered actin disruptors from 0.10 to 0.05 despite atlas support.
- Built dose-response rho=+/-1.00 from single wells per dose (e7-e9, e11) and ignored rep1 vs rep2 discordance at 0.03 uM (e2 vs e15), leading to overconfident p=0.50.

Proposed next experiment: Stain parallel low-dose (0.01-0.1 uM) plates for F-actin (phalloidin) plus tubulin/DNA and blindly score binucleate cytokinesis failure and actin aggregates versus monopolar spindles, with latrunculin A as actin-disruptor control and Eg5 inhibitor/nocodazole as mitotic controls, plus pyrene-actin polymerization capping assay.
